card.Text: Distention is {{c1::swelling outward — being stretched or inflated}}.
card.Back Extra:
Ex: "Assess the abdomen, looking and palpating for DCAP-BTLS, rigidity (firm or soft), and distention."

Parts: dis- (apart) + tend- (stretch) — stretched apart.

Distinguish: rigidity = abnormal firmness of the abdominal wall; distention = abnormal swelling outward.

card.Text: Your chest-pain patient says the pain eases when he sits up and leans forward — a detail that answers the {{c1::Provocation/palliation::OPQRST element}} element of OPQRST.
card.Back Extra:
Cue: anything that makes the symptom better or worse — including the position the patient is most comfortable in — answers P.

Distinguish: where the symptom is and whether it moves is Region/radiation, not P.
